# Chess Rules — Official FIDE Laws

## Setup

### Board

The chessboard is composed of 64 equal squares alternately light and dark.

### Pieces

- Each player starts with 16 pieces.
- King, Queen, 2 Rooks, 2 Bishops, 2 Knights, 8 Pawns.

## Movement

### King

The King moves one square in any direction.

### Pawn

- Pawns move forward one square.
- On first move, pawns may advance two squares.
- Pawns capture diagonally.

## Special Rules

### Castling

The King moves two squares toward a Rook, and the Rook moves to the other side.

### En passant

A pawn that advances two squares may be captured en passant by an adjacent pawn.
